task_objective: Add Oracle and PostgreSQL SQL source dialects without adding execution backends.
tests_added: Mapping values resolve to sqlglot dialects and the input selector exposes Oracle/postgres.
Oracle NVL and PostgreSQL casts transpile for DuckDB and Spark.
MainWindow executes Oracle and PostgreSQL source queries against a CSV with DuckDB.
Oracle ROWNUM and DUAL produce Messages panel diagnostics before execution.
EngineKind and MainWindow's engine selector contain only DuckDB and Spark.
design_decisions: Oracle and PostgreSQL are source-language choices only; EngineKind remains unchanged.
Only ROWNUM and FROM DUAL are blocked because sqlglot emits them unchanged for local execution.
The existing MessagesPanel diagnostic path reports blocked Oracle constructs.

transpilation.postgres_to_duckdb: SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) FROM t
transpilation.postgres_to_spark: SELECT CAST(id AS STRING) FROM t

verification.diagnostic: Oracle construct ROWNUM cannot run against the selected local engine. Rewrite the query without it before running.

results: The feature preserves the two local execution backends and passes the required quality gates.
